data.explanation: This invoice is for your personal share (Eigenanteil) of your new hearing aids, after your health insurance already covered its fixed amount (Festbetrag). It covers €1,380.00 for the hearing systems plus €20.00 statutory co-payment (gesetzliche Zuzahlung), totaling €1,400.00. Pay this amount to the provider's account by the deadline shown. If you can't pay it all at once, the provider allows installment payments by arrangement (nach Absprache) – contact them to set this up before the deadline. Keep this invoice as proof; hearing aid costs can often be claimed as extraordinary medical expenses (außergewöhnliche Belastungen) on your tax return, so check with a tax advisor if useful.
